content.title: Fashion Editorial Carousel | Identity-Locked Looks and Master-Title Return
content.summary: An adult model cycles through five original tailoring systems in one editorial index. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity persists across every outfit and crop. + Each outfit occupies a discrete graphic chapter with no mid-body morphing. + A recurring grid, number system and palette connect all modules. + Close and full views alternate without changing the subject's anatomy. + The master title and identity return together in the terminal lockup.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original adult model with a short silver bob inside a navy-cream-coral editorial grid titled "FORM INDEX". Alternate one close portrait with one full-body pose, retaining the same grid coordinates and section numbers. Return to the silver-bob model in one stable hero pose beneath the exact title "FORM INDEX / 05".
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity persists across every outfit and crop.
Each outfit occupies a discrete graphic chapter with no mid-body morphing.
Close and full views alternate without changing the subject's anatomy.
The master title and identity return together in the terminal lockup.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult model cycles through five original tailoring systems in one editorial index. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先锁定同一成年模特，再让不同造型在统一红黑白网格、编号和字块中逐章轮转；版式节拍替代随机换景，终局以同一人物和总标题完成身份回扣。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity persists across every outfit and crop.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity persists across every outfit and crop."

invariants.rule: Each outfit occupies a discrete graphic chapter with no mid-body morphing.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each outfit occupies a discrete graphic chapter with no mid-body morphing."

invariants.rule: A recurring grid, number system and palette connect all modules.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "A recurring grid, number system and palette connect all modules."

invariants.rule: Close and full views alternate without changing the subject's anatomy.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Close and full views alternate without changing the subject's anatomy."

invariants.rule: The master title and identity return together in the terminal lockup.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The master title and identity return together in the terminal lockup."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
